claims_supported: Traffic mirroring/shadowing sends a copy of live traffic to a mirrored service out of band of the primary path.
The worked example keeps 100% on v1 and mirrors 100% to v2; mirrorPercentage can mirror a fraction.
Mirrored requests are fire-and-forget and their responses are discarded.
Mirrored requests are real requests that reach v2 and appear in v2 access logs.
claims_not_supported: side-effect suppression, idempotency or write isolation
limitations: Template bug makes served YAML manifests unreliable; raw Markdown not fetched.
No production warning about duplicate writes.
